Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
I'm proud to report the results of our year-long league.
You can find the report of last year's league  here

This year's league was won by myself  I'm granted the honorific Senechal title for 2012.

Rules
The system is slightly the same as last year, except the year has been divided into 2 periods, the score being reset at the start of the 2nd period so that if someone joins during the year, he has a chance to win; another major difference is that the GW now grants you the double of points for a clan, and that Imbued and Caitiff are considered as "clans".

The player scoring the biggest score in either of both periods is the winner.

Keeping track of the results is very simple. All you need is to ask people scoring points on the table how much they scored (and if they have the GW), and which clan they played. A simple excel sheet I'd gladly share with anyone interested allows to compute the total score of each player and clan.

In order to compute each player's points, proceed by clan (a deck using a "star" vampire uses his or her clan) and take the best score for each clan.
The sum of these best scores gives the player's total points.

Eg. Vincent plays 15 times a Baali deck, and his best score with that clan is GW 4. He scores 8 points.
Tim plays once a Malkavian deck (1,5 VP), 7 times a Tremere deck (best score GW 3) and twice a turbo Una deck (!Gangrel) (best score 1 VP). He scores 1,5 + 6 + 1 = 8,5 points.

In order to win the title, one must play the most possible different decks and score with each (possibly playing the same clan a few times to improve that clan's score).
